name: toolradar
description: Recommend, compare, and get verified pricing for 8,600+ software tools.
long_description:
Toolradar gives Claude live access to a curated database of 8,600+ software tools: semantic search, budget-aware recommendations, side-by-side comparisons, real alternatives, verified pricing tiers, and aggregated G2/Capterra ratings. Data is refreshed continuously from vendors' own pricing pages.

No API key needed: the first 40 calls a day are free and anonymous. A free key (no signup, see the README) raises the limit to 300 a day.

api_key.title: Toolradar API key
api_key.description: Optional. Works without a key (40 calls a day); a free key raises it to 300 a day. Create one with no signup: POST https://toolradar.com/api/v1/keys

tools.name: recommend_tools
tools.description: Budget- and team-aware tool recommendations for a stated need

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search 8,600+ tools by keyword, category, and pricing model

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full profile of one tool: scores, ratings, features, FAQs

tools.name: get_pricing
